base_commit_binding.rule: This commit is published. It is never changed, never amended and never replaced. Its tree and parent list are bound here so any rewrite is detected mechanically.

third_binding_commit_rationale: The runtime evidence area is gitignored, so no committed artefact needs a digest of another committed artefact of this block. Every binding used here is either a git object of an earlier commit or a digest of a file that is not itself rewritten by a later B0a-4 commit.

plan_deviation.reason: The mandatory validation before the owner activation found that /usr/bin/python3 on this machine is a stub that resolves into a developer tools bundle owned by the guarded session user. Activating the first candidate would have put a session writable interpreter into the trust chain and, because of the path equality check, would additionally have blocked every tool call. The defect had to be corrected in a commit before the activation; amending the first commit is forbidden, so a second implementation commit was unavoidable and the evidence commit moved to position three.
